studies.title: The transatlantic telegraph
studies.caption: A lasting cable between Ireland and Newfoundland carries messages in minutes rather than weeks.
studies.prompt: Close deck-level scene on an1866 cable-laying ship, thick insulated telegraph cable passing over a large stern sheave into the sea, workers watching the tension, coiled cable and heavy iron machinery. Small inset-like cut end reveals protective wire layers; no modern fiber optic cable.
